key_privacy_section_1_intro: We collect personal information to provide and improve our services. This includes:
key_privacy_section_1_1_item1: Name, email address, phone number, and date of birth.
key_privacy_section_1_1_item2: Employment details (e.g., job preferences, skills, work experience).
key_privacy_section_1_1_item3: Profile details such as nationality, languages spoken, photos, and references.
key_privacy_section_1_2_item1: Device and usage data, such as IP address, browser type, operating system, and app interactions.
key_privacy_section_1_2_item2: Geolocation data when you use location-based features or grant location access.
key_privacy_section_1_2_item3: Cookies and similar technologies to track activity on our Platform.
key_privacy_section_1_3_item1: Data from social media accounts (e.g., Facebook, Google) when used for registration.
key_privacy_section_1_3_item2: Verification data from Partner Agencies or third-party services.
key_privacy_section_2_intro: We use your information for the following purposes:
key_privacy_section_2_item1: To provide and manage our services, including job matching and interview scheduling.
key_privacy_section_2_item2: To facilitate communication between Employers, Workers, and Partner Agencies.
key_privacy_section_2_item3: To verify your identity and ensure compliance with legal requirements.
key_privacy_section_2_item4: To send notifications and updates related to your account and activities.
key_privacy_section_2_item5: To analyze usage patterns and improve our Platform's functionality.
key_privacy_section_2_item6: To protect against fraud, unauthorized access, or illegal activities.
key_privacy_section_3_intro: We may share your personal information under the following circumstances:
key_privacy_section_3_1_item1: Worker profiles, including name, work experience, and references, are shared with Employers and Partner Agencies to facilitate job matching, interview scheduling, and contract processing.
key_privacy_section_3_1_item2: Employer job details are shared with Workers and Partner Agencies as part of the placement process.
key_privacy_section_3_1_item3: Partner Agency details, including names and license numbers, are shared during interview scheduling.
key_privacy_section_3_2_item1: Third-party vendors for analytics, marketing, and customer support.
key_privacy_section_3_3_item1: When required by law or legal process, such as subpoenas or court orders.
key_privacy_section_3_3_item2: To protect our rights, users, and Platform from fraud or illegal activity.
key_privacy_section_3_4_item1: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of our assets, your information may be transferred to the new entity.
key_privacy_section_4_intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
key_privacy_section_4_1_item1: Request access to the personal data we hold about you.
key_privacy_section_4_1_item2: Request corrections to inaccurate or incomplete data.
key_privacy_section_4_2_item1: Request a copy of your data in a portable format.
key_privacy_section_4_3_item1: Request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal retention requirements.
key_privacy_section_4_4_item1: Opt-out of marketing communications at any time.
key_privacy_section_4_4_item2: Restrict the processing of your personal data for certain purposes.
key_privacy_section_4_5_item1: You will not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights.

key_privacy_section_5_intro: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to:
key_privacy_section_5_item1: Fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy.
key_privacy_section_5_item2: Comply with legal and regulatory requirements.
key_privacy_section_5_item3: Resolve disputes and enforce our terms.
key_privacy_section_5_conclusion: When no longer needed, your data will be securely deleted or anonymized.
key_privacy_section_6_intro: We implement robust security measures to protect your personal information, including:
key_privacy_section_6_item1: Encryption for data in transit and at rest.
key_privacy_section_6_item3: Regular monitoring for vulnerabilities and breaches.
key_privacy_section_6_conclusion: Despite these efforts, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.
key_privacy_section_7_intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
key_privacy_section_7_item2: Track and analyze usage patterns on our Platform.
key_privacy_section_7_conclusion: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
key_privacy_section_8_text: Your information may be transferred to and stored in countries outside your own, including jurisdictions that may not provide the same level of data protection. We ensure such transfers comply with applicable legal requirements.
key_privacy_section_9_text: MaidMatch is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
key_privacy_section_10_text: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Updates will be posted on this page with the "Effective Date" updated. Continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of the revised Privacy Policy.
